title: Straylight Control Plane lane record (v1)
description: Reduced lane state. Published contract; the executable validator is .straylight/lib/validate.mjs#validateLane. GitHub issues identify lanes; this record is derived by reducing the lane's append-only event record.

state.description: eligibility-pending: an ACCEPT audit is recorded but not yet confirmed against live PR metadata. Only a system.eligibility_confirmed event whose payload durably embeds the successfully-checked metadata advances the lane to ready-for-merge.

next_actor.description: Projection of state, never independent authority: the executable validator rejects any record whose next_actor differs from the value derived from its state.

working_branch.description: Established by the INITIAL coordinator task packet (its target_branch). Every later packet, implementer completion (head_branch), audit (head_branch), and confirmed live PR head branch must match it exactly.

audit_retry.description: Consecutive retryable CANNOT_AUDIT requeues; capped at 3, reset by implementer.completed.

mode.description: Control Plane v1 permits shadow mode only. The validator rejects 'active'.

auto_merge_allowed.description: Control Plane v1 forbids automatic merge. The validator rejects true.

last_lease_role.description: Role whose lease was last reaped by system.lease_expired; routes system.requeued to the correct retry state (implementer→ready-for-claude, auditor→ready-for-codex). Cleared on requeue.

lease.description: Embedded-lease invariants enforced by the executable validator: lease.lane_id must equal the parent lane's lane_id (no cross-lane lease); lease.expected_state must equal the parent lane's current state (no cross-state lease); and expected_state must be the holder role's working state (implementer→claude-working, auditor→codex-working).

holder_login.description: Authenticated GitHub login that acquired the lease. Completion/release/block/escalation must come from this same login.

acquired_at.description: Trusted GitHub comment created_at at grant time, not the actor-supplied occurred_at. Millisecond precision at most.

expires_at.description: Strict UTC calendar instant; at most millisecond (3-digit) fractional precision.
